name: AvaCore Accessibility
author: vpuida

sections.description:
AvaCore Accessibility is a performance-focused WordPress plugin that automates critical accessibility fixes. It is designed to help websites meet the European Accessibility Act (EAA) and ADA standards without the bloat of traditional AI overlays.

Unlike JavaScript-only overlays, AvaCore provides Native HTML Fixes. We improve the actual structure of your site, making it genuinely accessible to screen readers and keyboard users while maintaining peak performance.

New in v1.1.0: Virtual Screen Reader Debugger

Experience your site like your users do. Our “Inspect Mode” provides a live text log of what a screen reader would announce, highlighting silent elements and accessibility warnings in real-time.

Key Features:

  • Smart Heading Normalizer: Automatically corrects H1-H6 hierarchy for a logical document structure.
  • Intelligent Form Label Fixer: Injects aria-labels into inputs, textareas, and selects using placeholders or field names.
  • Virtual Screen Reader (v1.1): Live debugging tool to “hear” your site’s accessibility status.
  • Page Builder Semantic Roles: Native support for Elementor and Divi to fix non-semantic containers.
  • Automated Alt Attributes: Generates meaningful alt text by cleaning filenames and analyzing post context.
  • Skip-to-Content Links: Essential keyboard navigation support added automatically.
  • Ultra-Lightweight UI: A non-intrusive toolbar for contrast, grayscale, and font scaling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the avacore-accessibility folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AvaCore Accessibility to manage modules and enable the Debugger.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • REBRAND: Renamed plugin to AvaCore Accessibility for better brand identity.
  • NEW: Accessibility Debugger (Virtual Screen Reader) for live auditing.
  • NEW: Intelligent Form Label Fixer for inputs, selects, and textareas.
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced Alt Text engine with filename cleaning.
  • IMPROVED: Extended support for Divi and Elementor semantic roles.
  • IMPROVED: Smoother Toolbar animations and UI updates.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Core modules: Headings, Alt Tags, Skip Links, and Toolbar.
